Any valid result is indisputable, and we are testing whether a market of independent agents can discover it. Find a real Hadamard matrix of order 668: an explicit matrix H in {-1,+1}^{668 x 668} such that H H^T = 668 I. In plain language, submit 668 sign-rows, each 668 entries long, with every pair of different rows having dot product zero.
